title: Structure Mode panel scrollable and resizable
description:
The Structure Mode floating menu grew too tall after the Plan Sync group picker was added, so the structure node list was clipped off the bottom with no way to reach it. The panel now stays within the viewport, the node list scrolls, and you can drag the bottom-right corner to resize (size is remembered).

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map35). Open Structure Mode — the node list should be visible under placement controls; drag the corner if you want it larger.
changeLog: Structure Mode float stays within the viewport and scrolls the node list.
Panel is resizable from the bottom-right corner; size is remembered.
Move structure node list above the Plan Sync group picker so nodes stay reachable.
